candidate.blueprint_locator: Pharmacological and Parenteral Therapies, printed p.12 / PDF p.16: Handle and maintain medication in a safe and controlled environment; Dispose of medications safely
candidate.educational_objective: Remove expired medications from patient-use stock and follow the facility process for replacement or disposal.

options.A: Remove it from patient-use stock and follow facility procedure for replacement or disposal
options.B: Administer it if no non-expired dose is immediately available
options.C: Change the expiration date if the medication appears unchanged
options.D: Leave it in the drawer if the package is intact

candidate.rationale: Under 42 CFR § 482.25(b)(3), outdated drugs and biologicals must not be available for patient use. Therefore, an expired medication should be removed from usable medication stock and handled through the facility's replacement/disposal process. B would make an outdated drug available for use; C cannot make an outdated drug current; and D leaves an outdated drug available for patient use.
candidate.source_claim_supported: Outdated drugs and biologicals must not be available for patient use.
